text: Hisa Takei
{character:Hisa Takei}I can't believe we played until sunset! That was fun!
Mihoko Fukuji
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}Thank you for letting us play here for so long.
Wanjirou
{character:Wanjirou}You're welcome. It was a real eye-opener for me too, woof.
Kaguyahime
{character:Kaguyahime}Hmph! You didn't do much better than me!
{character:Wanjirou}I'm very satisfied to see a duel between experts, woof.
{character:Kaguyahime}Hmph, if I wasn't feeling under the weather, I would show all of you the true might of a deity!
Toki Onjoji
{character:Toki Onjoji}(Those ears keep moving... I really want to pet them.)
Ako Atarashi
{character:Ako Atarashi}Well, I'm leaving with Miss Onjoji now to explain her situation to her team. Bye.
{character:Toki Onjoji}Ah... I'm so sorry, can you go inside with me once again? I forgot to pray for a blessing for the tournament.
{character:Ako Atarashi}You better hurry up then. But if you ask me, you need to pray for better health instead.
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}We'll be on our way then. So long.
{character:Hisa Takei}Let's find a time to play together again!
{character:Hisa Takei}The people Ichihime brought with her all had interesting ways of playing.
Hisa mentions how Toki had to rest again after playing one Hanchan because she wasn't feeling well.
And Ichihime, who had gone out to find other players, happened to return at that moment. While Ako was resting, she sat at the table and played with the other guests.

{character:Hisa Takei}It would be great if we could come again before the tournament. I need to get Yuuki and the others to play against more types of players. It'll help them improve for the tournament.
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}It's a pity that we were so busy playing Mahjong that we forgot to pray for a blessing.
{character:Hisa Takei}Pray for a blessing? Oh! I almost forgot about that.
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}But I bought this when we entered the shrine. Hisa, this is for you. I hope it'll give you some peace of mind.
Hisa looks at the lucky charm in Mihoko's hand with a dazed expression.
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}What is it? Do you not carry this type of thing?
{character:Hisa Takei}It's not that. I just want to say... We thought of the same thing again.
As she speaks, Hisa also takes out a lucky charm. Coincidentally, the brown and blue amulets matched Mihoko's eye color perfectly.
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}You... When did you buy this?
{character:Hisa Takei} That isn't important. What's important is that you accept them, Mihoko.
{character:Hisa Takei}Good luck in the individual competition!
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}...Hehe, that's really... reassuring.
In the 21st century, there are more than 100 million Mahjong experts who participate in competitions and many eye-catching professional Mahjong players.

High schools hold large-scale national tournaments every year. As their results are directly related to whether they can be promoted to professional players, members of high school mahjong clubs compete fiercely...
This is the story of some girls who are aiming to reach the top.
{character:Hisa Takei}Speaking of which, didn't Wanjirou say that something good will happen if we win games at Mahjong Soul Shrine?
{character:Mihoko Fukuji}You're right. Something good... Maybe he was right after all.
{character:Hisa Takei}What good thing has happened? Actually, it doesn't matter, just having fun was enough!
